import PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_InterpolationDenominator
open PV_L2C_M31
local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 2147483647) := ⟨R0Z.m31_prime⟩

def raw (i : Nat) : word := BitVec.ofNat 32 i

theorem raw_canonical (i : Nat) (hi : i < 28) : canonical (raw i) := by
  change i%2^32 < 2147483647
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  omega
#print axioms raw_canonical

theorem raw_decoded (i : Nat) (hi : i < 28) : decode (raw i) = PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.node i := by
  unfold decode raw PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.node
  rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
#print axioms raw_decoded

def run (i : Nat) : Nat → word
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => if n=i then run i n else
      PV_L2C_NativeMultiply.mul (run i n) (sub (raw i) (raw n))

theorem canonical_result (i n : Nat) : canonical (run i n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => change 1 < 2147483647;omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [run]
    split
    · exact ih
    · exact PV_L2C_NativeMultiply.canonical_result _ _
#print axioms canonical_result

theorem decoded (i n : Nat) (hi : i < 28) (hn : n ≤ 28) :
    decode (run i n) = PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.denominator i n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [run,PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.denominator,decode]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hsmall : n < 28 := by omega
    rw [run,PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.denominator,Finset.prod_range_succ]
    by_cases he : n=i
    · rw [if_pos he,if_pos he]
      simpa only [mul_one,PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.denominator] using ih (by omega)
    · rw [if_neg he,if_neg he,PV_L2C_NativeMultiply.decoded,
        sub_decode _ _ (raw_canonical i hi) (raw_canonical n hsmall),
        raw_decoded i hi,raw_decoded n hsmall]
      rw [ih (by omega)]
      rfl
#print axioms decoded

theorem nonzero (i n : Nat) (hi : i < 28) (hn : n ≤ 28) : decode (run i n) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [decoded i n hi hn]
  exact PV_L2C_InterpolationNodes.nonzero i n hi hn
#print axioms nonzero

theorem inverse (i : Nat) (hi : i < 28) :
    PV_L2C_NativeInverse.run (run i 28) = .ok (PV_L2C_NativeInverse.chain (run i 28)) ∧
    canonical (PV_L2C_NativeInverse.chain (run i 28)) ∧
    decode (PV_L2C_NativeInverse.chain (run i 28)) = (decode (run i 28))⁻¹ :=
  PV_L2C_InverseField.complete _ (canonical_result i 28) (nonzero i 28 hi (by omega))
#print axioms inverse
end PV_L2C_InterpolationDenominator

import PV_L2C_N3Guard
import PV_L2C_SampledBase
import PV_L2C_SampledMaskOnly
import PV_L2C_SampledSecure
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_MaterialN3
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_M31 PV_L2C_StateSampler

/-- Source-call executions at the value cut, retaining start/end states and
sample failures. This stores no canonical-column or guard-success premise.
Native state/ownership/control association remains a separately audited cut. -/
structure Executions (S D : Type) (next : S → Result (word × S))
    (sourceNext : D → Result (word × D)) (input : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank) where
  active : Fin 1024 → Bool
  c1Dependent : Fin 16 → Usize
  cells : List PV_L2C_MaskRange.Cell
  c1Start : S
  c1End : S
  c1 : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank
  c1Returned : PV_L2C_SampledBase.applySampled next 16 input cells active c1Dependent c1Start = ok (.ok c1,c1End)
  maskValues : Fin 10 → List word
  maskStart : Fin 10 → S
  maskEnd : Fin 10 → S
  maskReturned : ∀ c, PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (scalar next 16) 1024 (maskStart c) = ok (.ok (maskValues c),maskEnd c)
  maskDependent : Usize
  dValues : List PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q
  dStart : D
  dEnd : D
  dReturned : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (secure sourceNext 16) 1024 dStart = ok (.ok dValues,dEnd)
  gValues : List PV_L2C_NativeQ.Q
  gStart : S
  gEnd : S
  gReturned : PV_L2C_SamplerFill.fill (secure next 16) 1024 gStart = ok (.ok gValues,gEnd)
  qDependent : Fin 1024

def base {S D : Type} {next : S → Result (word × S)} {sourceNext : D → Result (word × D)}
    {input : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank} (e : Executions S D next sourceNext input) (c : Fin 26) : List U32 :=
  if h : c.val < 16 then PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.column e.c1 ⟨c.val,h⟩
  else List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 1024 => (⟨PV_L2C_SampledMaskOnly.balanced
    (e.maskValues ⟨c.val-16,by have := c.isLt;omega⟩) e.active e.maskDependent r⟩ : U32))

theorem expected {S D : Type} {next : S → Result (word × S)} {sourceNext : D → Result (word × D)}
    {input : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank} (e : Executions S D next sourceNext input)
    (hi : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Canonical input) :
    PV_L2C_N3Guard.run (base e)
      (PV_L2C_SampledSecure.column e.active e.qDependent e.dValues)
      (PV_L2C_SampledSecure.column e.active e.qDependent e.gValues) = ok (.ok ()) := by
  apply PV_L2C_N3Guard.expected
  · intro c
    unfold base
    split
    · exact PV_L2C_SampledBase.returned next 16 input hi e.cells e.active e.c1Dependent
        e.c1Start e.c1End e.c1 e.c1Returned _
    · exact PV_L2C_SampledMaskOnly.guard next 16 _ _ _ (e.maskReturned _) e.active e.maskDependent
  · exact PV_L2C_SampledSecure.guard sourceNext 16 e.dStart e.dEnd e.dValues e.dReturned e.active e.qDependent
  · exact PV_L2C_SampledSecure.guard next 16 e.gStart e.gEnd e.gValues e.gReturned e.active e.qDependent
#print axioms expected

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
include K in
theorem transfer {S D : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (sourceNext : D → Result (word × D))
    (t : PV_L2C_ClientRoute.Transfer)
    (e : Executions S D next sourceNext (PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.bank t.compiled.semantic_c1.c1)) :
    PV_L2C_N3Guard.run (base e)
      (PV_L2C_SampledSecure.column e.active e.qDependent e.dValues)
      (PV_L2C_SampledSecure.column e.active e.qDependent e.gValues) = ok (.ok ()) :=
  expected e (PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.transfer_bank (K:=K) t)
#print axioms transfer

include K in
theorem withdrawal {S D : Type} (next : S → Result (word × S)) (sourceNext : D → Result (word × D))
    (t : PV_L2C_ClientRoute.Withdrawal)
    (e : Executions S D next sourceNext (PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.bank t.compiled.semantic_c1.c1)) :
    PV_L2C_N3Guard.run (base e)
      (PV_L2C_SampledSecure.column e.active e.qDependent e.dValues)
      (PV_L2C_SampledSecure.column e.active e.qDependent e.gValues) = ok (.ok ()) :=
  expected e (PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard.withdrawal_bank (K:=K) t)
#print axioms withdrawal
end PV_L2C_MaterialN3

import PV_L2C_HonestHelper
import PV_L2C_QFold
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_HelperReturn
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QFold

def run (values : List Q) : Option Q :=
  if values.length = 1024 then some (PV_L2C_QBalance.foldQ values zero) else none

theorem expected (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (hc : ∀ r, Canonical (table r))
    (hz : (∑ r, decodeQ (table r)) = 0) : run (List.ofFn table) = some zero := by
  rw [run,List.length_ofFn,if_pos rfl]
  apply congrArg some
  change tableSum table = zero
  apply decode_injective _ _ (tableSum_canonical table hc) zero_canonical
  rw [tableSum_decode table hc,hz,zero_decode]
#print axioms expected

theorem rejects_shape (values : List Q) (hl : values.length ≠ 1024) : run values = none := by
  rw [run,if_neg hl]
#print axioms rejects_shape

open R1Z R0P R0Z.ZkStatement
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

theorem honest (F : Subfield K) (B : PackBasis F) (i : PV_L2C_HonestCaller.Family (K:=K))
    (lam chi : K) (project : K →+ (Fin 4 → ZMod PV_L2C_M31.p))
    (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (hc : ∀ r, Canonical (table r))
    (association : ∀ r, decodeQ (table r) = project (R0Z.HonestView.helper
      ((PV_L2C_HonestCaller.source (K:=K)).public i)
      ((PV_L2C_HonestCaller.source (K:=K)).build i) lam chi r)) :
    run (List.ofFn table) = some zero := by
  apply expected table hc
  simp only [association,← map_sum,PV_L2C_HonestHelper.total F B i lam chi,map_zero]
#print axioms honest
end PV_L2C_HelperReturn

import PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_SumcheckControl
open R1Z R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.PayloadSplit R0Z.RefPayload
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
inductive Failure where
  | boundary : Nat → Failure
  | terminal

def boundary (round : Nat) (poly : Polynomial K) (running : K) : Except Failure Unit :=
  if poly.eval 0 + poly.eval 1 ≠ running then .error (.boundary round) else .ok ()
def terminal (oracle running : K) : Except Failure Unit :=
  if oracle ≠ running then .error .terminal else .ok ()

variable [Fintype K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
  {F : Subfield K}

theorem initial (B : PackBasis F) (i : PV_L2C_HonestCaller.Family (K:=K))
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K)
    (hnp : R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole ((PV_L2C_HonestCaller.source (K:=K)).build i) (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    boundary 0 (rounds ch 0 (PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.oracle B i ch))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b => maskLinear BuilderSource.π B (ofBool b)
        ((PV_L2C_HonestCaller.source (K:=K)).build i))) = .ok () := by
  rw [boundary,PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.initial B i ch hnp,if_neg (by simp)]
#print axioms initial

theorem chained (B : PackBasis F) (i : PV_L2C_HonestCaller.Family (K:=K))
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (r : Fin 9) :
    boundary r.succ.val (rounds ch r.succ (PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.oracle B i ch))
      ((rounds ch r.castSucc (PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.oracle B i ch)).eval
        (R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch r.castSucc)) = .ok () := by
  rw [boundary,PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.chain B i ch r,if_neg (by simp)]
#print axioms chained

theorem final (B : PackBasis F) (i : PV_L2C_HonestCaller.Family (K:=K))
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) :
    terminal (PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.oracle B i ch (R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch))
      ((rounds ch 9 (PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.oracle B i ch)).eval (R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch 9)) = .ok () := by
  rw [terminal,PV_L2C_HonestSumcheck.terminal B i ch,if_neg (by simp)]
#print axioms final
end PV_L2C_SumcheckControl
